The competition

About the Aras League

More than a competition: a community built around football, fair play and the pursuit of the title.

The format

Eighteen clubs play each other home and away across the season. Every point counts in the race for the title.

European places

The top two qualify for the Champions League, third enters the play-off and fourth goes to the Europa League.

Fair play

Respect for opponents, referees and fans is at the heart of everything the league does.

What is the Aras League?

The Aras League is a football competition where clubs battle across a full season to be crowned champions. The club with the most points at the end of the season lifts the trophy, while the club in last place is relegated.

Our mission

We bring players and fans together, promote sportsmanship, and give every club the chance to show what they can do on the pitch.

Points system

A win earns 3 points, a draw 1 point and a defeat 0. If clubs finish level on points, goal difference decides, followed by goals scored.
